anti_rework_rules.rule: Survey before designing: no placement, channel or hardware decision until attenuation, spectrum and pathway facts are measured
anti_rework_rules.prevents: redesigning and re-ordering after concrete walls, saturated spectrum or blocked pathways surface mid-install

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the segment matrix before selecting hardware
anti_rework_rules.prevents: buying a platform that cannot map SSIDs to VLANs with per-segment policy and having to re-buy or bodge the security design

anti_rework_rules.rule: Reconcile the vendor's licensing mechanism against the offer before any hardware order
anti_rework_rules.prevents: margin-eating surprise per-AP fees and awkward re-quotes after the gear is already on site

anti_rework_rules.rule: Get the disclosure text and venue sign-off before building the portal's collection flow
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding the splash flow and purging wrongly collected records after a privacy objection or field mismatch

anti_rework_rules.rule: Compute the PoE and port budget with headroom before pulling any cable
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-pulls, switch swaps and phantom AP reboots when powered devices exceed what the closet can feed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the ISP's WAN handoff mode during scope intake, not on install day
anti_rework_rules.prevents: double-NAT firefighting with the venue watching and the portal broken during cutover

anti_rework_rules.rule: Test segment isolation before any guest device can associate
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an exposed payment or office segment discovered by a stranger's phone instead of by the crew

anti_rework_rules.rule: Pin firmware and capture the config export before validation starts
anti_rework_rules.prevents: chasing test failures against a target that auto-updated mid-suite and invalidated half the results

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the as-built during install and validation, never from memory afterward
anti_rework_rules.prevents: documentation reconstruction visits and docs that describe the plan instead of the site

iteration_protocol.trigger: validation fails a coverage, roaming or capacity target
iteration_protocol.action: revise the placement and channel plan against the model for the affected areas, re-install as needed, and re-run the failed tests plus their blast radius

iteration_protocol.trigger: an isolation test finds cross-segment reachability in either direction
iteration_protocol.action: freeze go-live, correct the VLAN assignment or firewall rule, re-run the full bidirectional isolation matrix, and record the failure and fix in the handoff evidence

iteration_protocol.trigger: the venue adds areas, devices or powered equipment mid-deployment
iteration_protocol.action: re-open the scope intake, re-survey what changed, and recompute the affected targets, placement and PoE budget before installing the addition

iteration_protocol.trigger: the venue or a marketing partner requests new portal fields or new uses of collected data
iteration_protocol.action: update the disclosure and consent flow, obtain fresh written venue sign-off, verify consent rules for the jurisdiction, and redeploy the portal before any new collection starts

iteration_protocol.trigger: a busy-hour performance complaint arrives after go-live but before signed acceptance
iteration_protocol.action: re-survey at the complained hour, adjust channels, power or placement, and re-validate capacity under the conditions that produced the complaint

iteration_protocol.trigger: the platform vendor changes licensing, deprecates settings or retires the hardware line mid-project
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the affected platform-selection tests, reconcile cost changes with the offer owner, update the template and bill of materials, and note the change in the docs

iteration_protocol.trigger: punch-list items remain open at the scheduled handoff date
iteration_protocol.action: hold the operations gate, classify remaining items as blockers or dated ride-alongs with venue acknowledgment, and pass only what the gate's conditions actually cover

iteration_protocol.trigger: a doc-versus-site mismatch or a missing gate condition surfaces after handoff
iteration_protocol.action: correct the as-built package, refresh the archived baseline, and feed the missed condition back into the gate checklist for future sites

required_checks: all edge ids unique EDGE_XXX format
all from/to in edges reference valid node ids
all competency_question_refs resolve to valid CQ ids
all evidence_refs resolve to valid source_registry ids
all priority_order entries are valid node ids with no duplicates
high_risk_nodes (risk_if_wrong>=0.80) have non-empty acceptance_tests and human_review_required=true
conflict edges have signed_tension<0 and resolution_rule present
observed_impact=0.0 for all nodes (no observed data)
19-24 nodes, 32-40 edges, 8-10 conflict_axes, 10-12 edge_cases, 9-12 workflow steps
post_formula_checks: all derived fields non-zero after compute run
